The area of a circle is A = πr². For a right triangle, a² + b² = c², so c = √(a² + b²). Angles are measured in degrees (45°) or in radians (π/4 rad). Use × for multiplication and ÷ for division when writing by hand. The inequality symbols ≤ and ≥ mean "less than or equal to" and "greater than or equal to" — note the curly quotes and the em dash in this sentence. Some students write θ for an unknown angle; others prefer α or β. Naïve rounding can introduce error, so keep at least three significant figures until the final step.
